rules.title: Rules & modes
rules.lede: When something holds, do something. The rules come from the application's presets and from you; a mode changes what happens for a while.
rules.name: Name
rules.not_found: That rule or mode was not found.
rules.name_taken: A rule by that name already exists.
rules.need_name_when: A rule needs a name and a condition.
rules.csrf_refused: The form had expired; try again.
rules.grammar: A condition compares readings — heater.temperature < 24.5, filter-main.switch == on — joined by and, or, not, brackets; mode == feeding; time between 10:00 and 20:00. Actions, separated by ;: switch <item> on|off, use <item>, alert <level> "message", journal <level> "message", mode <name>, mode end.
